add_account_steps.step_1_desc: Click "Save Current" to backup the account you're currently using.
add_account_steps.step_2_desc: Run the command below in Terminal to log out of the current account.
add_account_steps.step_3_desc: Run the "claude" command in Terminal; it will prompt you to log in again.
add_account_steps.step_4_desc: Return to this app and click "Save Current" to save the newly logged-in account.

messages.claude_running_warning: Ongoing sessions will continue using the current account. New sessions will use the switched account.
messages.delete_confirm: This action cannot be undone. Profile "{{name}}" will be permanently deleted from this device.
messages.no_credentials: No credentials found. Please log in to Claude CLI first.
messages.no_saved_profiles_info: Save current credentials to create a profile. Then log in with a different account and save again.
messages.preserve_context: Your project context, history, and settings will be preserved.
messages.restart_claude_warning: Please restart Claude Code to use the new credentials.
messages.token_expired_warning: This token has expired. It may automatically refresh next time it's used.
